observations.semantics: Bad CRC raises real decoder MAVError; the same complete-frame parser continues, manager catches the error and later publishes remaining components with missing primary defaults. Fragmentation and mavutil auto-negotiation are excluded.
Actual strict callback rejects malformed, wrong-ID, oversized, wrong-type, invalid-time, nonfinite and wrong-identifier inputs; valid data remains usable afterward.
